coverage_note: All continuous eligible prose on the 35 selected physical pages was read in the geometric extraction with neighboring context. Mathematical displays, code/literal identifiers and dense tables were excluded from grammar editing. Source registers were read for prose context while exact names, bibliographic titles, citation labels, dates, technical identifiers, and historical objects were preserved. Physical page 76 was additionally rendered and visually inspected to authenticate the malformed word. This is not a proof or source-theorem audit.

coverage_by_page.exclusions: mathematical formula tokens, dense numeric/claim-map tables, exact bibliographic titles and technical source identifiers; accompanying ordinary prose reviewed
